summary: Tiziana Life Sciences filed a 6-K furnishing a press release dated September 21, 2026, announcing that the last patient completed the last visit in its Phase 2a INFORM-MS trial of intranasal foralumab in non-active secondary progressive MS. The randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled study enrolled 48 patients across three cohorts at U.S. sites, evaluating two doses versus placebo over 12 weeks, with primary endpoint change in microglial activation by PET imaging. Database lock is expected this week, with 12-week topline data in October, followed by a six-month open-label extension.
